consent.title: Before we start
consent.intro: To find benefits for your family we need to ask a few questions. Here is what happens with your answers:
consent.i1: We ask only what the schemes need: age, work, income, family and documents.
consent.i2: Your answers stay on this phone. We never store a full Aadhaar number.
consent.i3: The result is guidance, not an official decision.
consent.i4: You can delete all your data any time in Settings.
consent.promise: Adhikar Mitra never asks for money or OTP. Applying is free.
